children: News Corp disclosed ongoing repurchases under its US$1 billion 2025 repurchase program, having bought approximately US$491,087,178 to date.
Daily ASX filings report the 2025 Repurchase Program authorizes up to US$1B of Class A and B shares to be repurchased.
On Sep 22, 2026 the company repurchased 12,238,906 shares for US$319,950,095.99 (Class A: 12,238,906 / Class B: 58,482 shown across notices).
Total repurchases under the program now approximate US$491,087,178 based on consideration paid to date.
Repurchases are intended to enhance shareholder value and may occur in the open market or otherwise, subject to market conditions.
